scope: all current and future material Powerhouse chats, agents, skills, workflows, scenarios, development runs, incidents, recoveries and production verifications
purpose: Make shared learning operational rather than conversational: every material worker reads current canonical state before work, executes already-authorized work without redundant confirmation loops, records what it does, persists every material error/decision/outcome/learning after work, refreshes shared context and proves that the next worker can discover the result quickly and securely.

autonomous_execution_contract.boundary_rule: Do not ask the user to reconfirm work already authorized by the standing Powerhouse operating contract. Continue independently through the existing secure delivery path. Ask only when a real authorization or decision boundary exists; when blocked technically, provide evidence and the minimal required action instead of generic confirmation-seeking.
autonomous_execution_contract.promotion_rule: When a material candidate is within existing Powerhouse authority and all required gates are green, the current chat/agent/workflow must invoke the canonical protected promotion/deploy path itself and continue through production readback; it must not hand routine promotion back to the user.
autonomous_execution_contract.recoverable_stop_rule: Queued CI, timeout, chat stop, lost worker, stale state, zero-run exact heads or non-terminal deploy state create a recoverable obligation owned by the same canonical lineage. Recovery must re-dispatch missing exact-head gates, preserve one writer lease and continue toward production.

writer_lease.terminal_delivery_rule: Only the lease owner may mutate the canonical branch while terminal delivery is active.

canonical_authorities.authority_change_rule: An authority ID may change only through an explicit migration/ADR with old-to-new lineage, readback and next-agent discoverability proof.

must_read: canonical system contract and System Map by canonical ID where available
relevant incident/error fingerprints and proven fixes
latest material agent activity for the touched component
source registry/provenance/security classification for every material internal or external data source used

mandatory_activity_ledger.rule: Record material actions as they happen; do not reconstruct the full audit trail only at the end.

data_and_evidence_contract.personal_or_confidential_data_rule: Store only the minimum necessary metadata and evidence reference allowed by purpose, access control and retention policy; do not duplicate raw sensitive payloads into general-purpose learning stores.
data_and_evidence_contract.external_data_rule: External information must retain source/provenance, observed_at or freshness, confidence and evidence reference so later agents can distinguish source fact from derived inference.
data_and_evidence_contract.derived_data_rule: Derived metrics, scores, model outputs and recommendations must retain lineage to inputs, version/formula/model where relevant, timestamp and confidence.

current_state_contract.rule: Keep current state compact and decision-ready. Historical details belong in append-only activity/incident/learning lineage; current state points to them instead of copying them.
current_state_contract.stale_state_rule: A state record without fresh verification identity is not production truth.

incident_learning_contract.rule: Every material incident becomes a reusable learning object. Known fingerprints are checked before diagnosis; repeated incidents must strengthen prevention or regression coverage.

error_learning_contract.known_error_rule: Match fingerprint before diagnosis and reuse a proven recovery before inventing a new one unless fresh evidence invalidates it.
error_learning_contract.repeat_error_rule: A repeated known error without fingerprint reuse is itself a material learning failure and must create a prevention action.

security_and_access_contract.rule: Security is part of the same delivery path, not a later checklist. Never copy credentials, tokens, raw secrets or unnecessary personal/confidential payloads into chat, Notion, logs or learning records.

write_to_existing_authorities: canonical Brain/Supabase learning and CurrentState when runtime/data learning applies
Powerhouse Agent Activity Log for human-operational traceability
Powerhouse Latest Verified State when verified state changes
Canonical System Map when architecture/ownership/routes change
Menselijk Handboek when human-readable operating knowledge changes
repository learning/policy/regression artifacts when machine enforcement changes

next_agent_discoverability_gate.rule: After writeback, refresh the shared context and perform a read-after-write from the same canonical ID-first discovery path used by a new worker. Completion is blocked unless the new state/learning fingerprint is discoverable there.

no_duplicate_truth.rule: Use existing Powerhouse authorities and ledgers. This contract adds enforcement requirements, not another business truth, memory database, scheduler, documentation tree or learning plane.

prevention: Treat autonomous execution within existing authority, structured current state, source lineage, security, activity logging, incident learning, human documentation and read-after-write discoverability as part of execution itself. A worker that needlessly stops for reconfirmation or that did useful work but failed to make that work securely discoverable to the next worker has not completed the task.

rules: Refresh candidate identity and gate state from current canonical authorities immediately before making a terminal claim.
A prior chat statement, cached status, open PR, CI state, deploy acknowledgement or transport success is never sufficient terminal proof.
An assertion that no production write occurred requires direct production/provider mutation or audit authority evidence; CI or unmerged-PR state alone cannot prove absence of writes.
If the candidate head has advanced, all earlier exact-head terminal evidence is superseded for the active candidate unless explicitly preserved as historical evidence.
Every terminal-status evaluation is appended to the material activity ledger with evidence references, including failed or incomplete evaluations.

LIVE_PROVEN requires exact candidate identity, required gates, protected promotion, production/provider readback, outcome/value, canonical learning writeback, prevention writeback and next-agent discoverability.
Missing proof must produce an explicit non-terminal status rather than optimistic language.

skill_execution_contract.terminal_success_requires: same canonical Powerhouse completion gates as chats and agents
skill_execution_contract.rule: A material skill is not a side utility outside Powerhouse. It is an execution capability inside the same canonical loop and must leave durable evidence, documentation, learning and discoverable state before terminal success.
